meta.purpose: Machine-readable evidence chain: for each beat and each per-turn AI data point, which ILR field it populates and which RARPA stage it satisfies, with a human-confirmation flag.
meta.ilr_note: Funding model 11 (Tailored Learning) or 38 (Adult Skills Fund). Non-regulated ESOL uses a Category B Z-code as LearnAimRef. In 2026/27 hours move to the HRSRecord entity. Exact current Z-code and HRSType codes are [UNVERIFIED - CONFIRM BEFORE BUILD].
meta.rarpa_note: Six-step L&W 2017 model; first five steps carry the assessment evidence.
meta.human_confirm_principle: AI judgements are formative/supporting evidence. Summative achievement, assessment reliability, eligibility and objective-negotiation require human teacher confirmation to be audit-defensible.

pre_session.note: ULN from LRS; postcode drives funder routing (GLA) and uplift.
Documentation seen and recorded, not photocopied (GDPR).
Recorded in the evidence pack; the baseline for progress.
PlanLearnHours at learner level; LearnAimRef is the Z-code or regulated aim.
Objective text + date + link to Stage 2 stored; learner negotiation must be evidenced.

beat_1_prepare.note: The session's Stage 3 objective is timestamped as engaged.
Vocabulary set logged to the ledger.
Session start logged; attendance evidence behind planned hours.

beat_2_roleplay.note: Self-scored by the same model; supporting evidence only, sample and moderate for reliability.
Feeds the ledger; evidences vocabulary growth and retention encounters.
Core Curriculum element codes (e.g. Sd/E1, Lr/E1); maps the turn to the fundable curriculum element.
Did the learner reuse the corrected form? Formative acquisition evidence.
Routed to the named DSL and the referral log; never left in the lesson flow.
Delivered learning time; attendance log reconciles against planned hours.

beat_3_complete.note: Marks the session finished; contributes to the hours record.
Plain-language distance-travelled statement against the objective.
The learner's own voice in the record, required by RARPA.

review_point.note: Teacher confirms achievement against the configurable threshold (commonly 75-80% of objectives, incl. at least one individual objective).
Sampled moderation of AI formative judgements for reliability/consistency (the Ofsted-flagged risk).
Progression into further learning, volunteering or employment recorded.

open_flags: [FLAG FOR EXPERT REVIEW: funding specialist] confirm this chain satisfies the GLA ASF Assurance Framework and the reliable/consistent/comparable assessment bar.
[FLAG FOR EXPERT REVIEW: funding specialist] confirm whether AI session logs are accepted attendance evidence for planned hours, and the current Z-code/hours band.
[FLAG FOR EXPERT REVIEW: DELTA practitioner] confirm the formative data points genuinely evidence progress against the objectives.
